content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the task reporting page","i_want":"to download the filtered task report as an Excel file","so_that":"I can analyse the report data in a spreadsheet outside the application","business_description":"The task report can be exported to Excel. The exported file contains only the rows that match the filters applied on the report page, in the applied sort order, so the data can be shared or analysed outside the application.","business_value":"Users can analyse and share the task data outside the application without rebuilding the filters and sort order by hand.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The task report page shows 12 tasks with no filters applied","when":"The user selects the Excel export action","then":"An Excel file is downloaded that contains 12 data rows, one per task"},{"given":"The report has the Status filter set to Open and is sorted by Due Date ascending","when":"The user selects the Excel export action","then":"The downloaded file contains only tasks with status Open, in ascending Due Date order"},{"given":"The user exports the report at a given moment","when":"The file is downloaded","then":"The file name contains the timestamp of the moment the file was generated"},{"given":"The applied filters match no tasks","when":"The user selects the Excel export action","then":"No Excel file is downloaded and a message is shown to the user explaining that there is no data to export"},{"given":"A report with at least one task is exported","when":"The user opens the downloaded Excel file","then":"The first row contains clear column headers and every date column uses the same date format"}],"edge_cases":["The applied filters match no tasks: a message must be shown. The PRD does not define the message wording or whether a file is still produced; this is an open question.","The PRD does not define the timestamp format or time zone used in the file name; this is an open question.","The PRD does not define which date format is used in the exported file; the team must choose one format and apply it to every date column.","It is not stated whether an active title search counts as an applied filter for the export; this must be confirmed.","The PRD does not state a maximum number of rows for one export or whether the export covers only the rows on the current page; this must be confirmed."],"dependencies":["US-filter-search-sort-report","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The export action downloads an Excel file that contains only the rows matching the applied filters.","The exported rows follow the applied sort order.","The file name includes the timestamp at which the file was generated.","The column headers are clear and all date columns use one consistent date format.","A message is shown instead of a file when no rows match the applied filters.","The decision on whether the Excel file is generated in the frontend or the backend is documented with rationale and trade-offs.","Automated tests for the export cover the cases in the acceptance criteria and pass."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"excel-export-generation-decision","title":"[BE] Decide and document where the Excel file is generated for the task report","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Decide whether the Excel file is generated in the frontend or the backend. Document the decision with rationale and trade-offs. Follow-up tasks for the chosen location are created after this decision is recorded.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-3a63e0ce"],"derived_reason":"decision_spike","is_spike":true,"definition_of_done":["A decision record states whether the Excel file is generated in the frontend or the backend.","The decision record includes the rationale and the trade-offs of the chosen option.","The decision record lists the follow-up tasks needed for the chosen option."]},{"key_slug":"report-excel-download-action","title":"[FE] Add Excel export action that downloads the filtered and sorted task report","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add an action on the task report page that downloads an Excel file. The file contains only the rows matching the applied filters, in the applied sort order, with clear column headers and one consistent date format for all date columns. The file name includes the generation timestamp. The data source depends on the outcome of the generation-location decision.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-52360b76","R-09e9d163","R-d22b9b6a","R-fad183b1"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The export action is visible on the task report page.","Selecting the action downloads an Excel file with only the rows matching the applied filters.","The rows follow the applied sort order.","The file name includes the generation timestamp.","Column headers are clear and all date columns use one date format."]},{"key_slug":"report-export-no-data-message","title":"[FE] Show a no-data message instead of an empty Excel file","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"When the applied filters match no tasks, show a message to the user and do not download an empty file. The wording of the message is not specified in the PRD and must be confirmed.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-437992f1"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["When no rows match, no file is downloaded.","A message is shown to the user when no rows match.","The message wording has been confirmed by the product owner."]},{"key_slug":"excel-export-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for the task report Excel export","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated tests for the Excel export: content matches filters and sort order, file name timestamp, column headers, date format consistency and the no-data case.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":[],"derived_reason":"testing","is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover filtered content, sort order, file name timestamp, headers, date format and the no-data case.","All export tests pass in the continuous integration pipeline."]}]}
